justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/utils/VisitorList.java` (lines 268-297) and the related `VisitorSet.java`/`VisitorMap.java` helpers. The target is a private inner helper with one field and only four behaviors: constructor, two `accept` methods that just throw `AssertionError`, and `hashCode`/`equals` delegating to the configured visitors. It has a single, narrow responsibility for list element identity; the surrounding `VisitorList` owns the actual list operations, so there is no evidence of excessive size, many methods, or separable responsibilities in this class.
